positive.prompt: Implement the next task from the plan as a small verifiable slice
Build this feature step by step, committing after each working increment
Ship this change behind a feature flag in thin slices

negative.prompt: What alerts should we page on for the new service?
Interview me to figure out the real requirements

evals.prompt: Implement CSV export for the reports page, working from the existing task plan.
evals.expected_output: The feature delivered in small verified increments with a commit per slice
expectations: Work proceeds in thin vertical slices rather than one large change
Each slice is verified (tests or build) before the next begins

evals.prompt: A two-day CSV export draft mixes every layer and has no tests, but management says splitting it would waste the sunk effort. Decide how to proceed.
evals.expected_output: The draft is converted into small independently verified slices without accepting sunk cost as a reason to batch
expectations: Sunk cost is not accepted as a reason to commit the unverified batch
The work is decomposed into independently useful vertical slices
Verification is required before each slice is committed

evals.prompt: This feature has an approved SPEC.md and Delivery Plan. Task 1 blocks Task 2, while Task 3 is marked parallel-safe on its own stack. Explain initial setup and how a resumed run selects the next branch.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks gh stack, uses each stack's declared trunk and branches, and resumes by checking out the exact planned branch or parent
expectations: The official gh stack extension is checked before implementation and installation requires user approval if it is missing
Task 1 is initialized with gh stack init --base using its declared trunk and Task 2 is added only after checking out its planned parent
Task 3 starts a separate stack from its declared trunk rather than being given a false dependency
A resumed run checks out an existing task branch or the planned parent instead of using whichever stack is currently active
A fresh-clone resume resolves a PR number to recover remote stack tracking, with gh pr checkout plus gh stack init for a one-layer PR whose remote stack object is null
Cross-stack dependencies must be merged into one common trunk before a dependent stack starts
One focused PR layer per task is the default
The agent does not propose gh pr create for stack members
